fields.name: ⏱️ Duration
fields.value: ={{ (() => { const a = ($json.body.alerts || [{}])[0]; if (!a.startsAt || !a.endsAt) return 'N/A'; const ms = new Date(a.endsAt) - new Date(a.startsAt); const m = Math.floor(ms/60000); const s = Math.floor((ms%60000)/1000); return (m > 0 ? m + 'm ' : '') + s + 's'; })() }}
